name: Cell C Holdings Limited
summary: Cell C Holdings Limited operates as a telecommunications and technology company in South Africa. The company offers wholesale services, such as telecommunication service comprises revenue generated from mobile virtual network operators (MVNO), mobile virtual network enablement (MVNE), and business service providers; postpaid and prepaid distribution services, including voice, SMS, data, WASP and contract charges; roaming services; fibre-to-the-home. comprises line rental, connection, and installation services. Cell C Holdings Limited was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Midrand, South Africa.
